aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.content: I am Leonardo Franco Arakaki, an Architecture and Urbanism student at FAUUSP, passionate about design, urbanism, and visual communication. I have academic and practical experience in visual identity projects, urban furniture, and architectural spaces, as well as solid training in interior design. I am always seeking new challenges and opportunities to apply my knowledge in innovative and sustainable projects.

languages.title: Language Competencies
languages.internationalExperienceContent: With advanced English proficiency (Cambridge Proficiency), I am prepared for international collaborations and academic opportunities abroad. My experience with multiple languages allows me to work on diverse projects and communicate effectively with international teams.

experiences.title: Professional Experience
experiences.professionalSummaryContent: Architecture and Urbanism student with experience in academic and practical projects. I have developed skills in design, urban planning, and visual communication through interdisciplinary projects and collaborations with colleagues from different areas.

experiencesList.title: Architecture Intern
experiencesList.description: Development of residential and commercial projects, creation of models and visual presentations.

experiencesList.title: Design Assistant
experiencesList.description: Creation of visual identity for local companies, development of graphic materials and branding.

education.title: Academic Education
education.academicTrajectoryContent: My education combines technical training in interior design with a degree in architecture and urbanism, providing a solid foundation in both practical and theoretical aspects of design. The experience at FAUUSP has allowed me to develop competencies in academic research, urban sustainability, and visual communication, always focusing on innovative and socially responsible projects.

educationList.institution: FAUUSP - Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism of USP
educationList.description: Complete training in architecture, urbanism, design, and construction technologies.
Basic education with focus on exact and human sciences.

projects.title: Projects and Portfolio
projects.methodologyContent: My projects follow a user-centered methodology, always considering aspects of sustainability, accessibility, and integration with the urban context. Each project is developed through research, context analysis, conceptual development, and technical detailing, ensuring innovative and functionally adequate solutions.

projectsList.title: Social Housing Project
projectsList.description: Development of architectural project for sustainable social housing with focus on energy efficiency and quality of life.

projectsList.title: Urban Requalification Plan
projectsList.description: Proposal for requalification of central city area, integrating green spaces, mobility, and housing.

projectsList.title: Visual Identity - Restaurant
projectsList.description: Complete creation of visual identity for themed restaurant, including logo, menu, and promotional materials.
